column1: # The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (US base + separate DLCs, update 4.04b / v262144), checked on the Mac from title into Kaer Morhen under both stock 64 GiB and 4.375 GiB iOS alias layouts; see README.md
# REDengine 3's DT_INIT_ARRAY[0] reserves a 48 GiB address region at main+0x89e8 and bumps four sub-ranges out of it (8 GiB small-block slabs, 32 GiB TLSF heap, 33.7 MiB and 40 MiB fixed pools).

# The engine-wide alias_only rule in dm/tools/engine_patches.py shrinks those reservations to 2.75 GiB (384 MiB small-block + 2.25 GiB TLSF) on iOS so the game fits the standard 5 GiB / 4.375 GiB unentitled iPhone block without extended-virtual-addressing; the Mac loader restores the original 48 GiB layout under its 64 GiB alias region (docs/reference/memory.md).
# the NPDM declares 4 MB of system resource

# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the game asks for present interval 2 once, at window creation, and has no other limit; display mode presents at the cap by the present interval alone, matching 0100A0800E9C4000
